method: Each listed stem/topic and new reference mapping was manually examined. Replacing current refs with the recorded oldRefs reproduces a prior independently approved full-item hash; this proves all other fields are unchanged. The present pass approves the manually assessed reference relevance while carrying forward that exact unchanged-content review. It is not a new full clinical review or an automated pass based solely on hash equality.
limitations: Independent AI editorial/clinical-reasoning screen; not external clinician validation or psychometric validation.
Pass applies only to the recorded content hash. New or changed content requires further review.
No comparison against proprietary examination items; originality judged from author provenance and item content.
Cross-bank learning-objective overlap remains provisional until all batches are available.
